patterns.note: Asymmetrical two-column layouts for feature sections, often with a large image on one side and text on the other, creating visual interest and ample whitespace.
Prominent use of a large, elegant serif typeface for main headings, paired with a clean, modern sans-serif for body text and navigation, establishing a sophisticated and readable hierarchy.
A sophisticated dark mode palette (charcoal/black, white, light grey) is used for backgrounds and text, punctuated by the natural colors from high-quality architectural photography.
A sticky header that transforms from transparent to solid dark with a slight height reduction upon scrolling past the hero section.
Content sections reveal with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, creating a guided scrolling experience.
Full-bleed hero video/image at the top, immediately establishing the brand's aesthetic and core offering.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes a full-bleed video background with a subtle dark overlay to ensure text legibility, providing an immersive initial experience.

A sticky header dynamically changes its appearance, transitioning from a transparent state over the hero to a solid, slightly condensed dark bar with a subtle shadow once the user scrolls past the initial viewport.

Content sections are introduced with scroll-triggered animations, where elements subtly fade into view or slide up from the bottom as they become visible in the viewport, enhancing engagement, likely using css-keyframes.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif headings (hero ~3-4x body) with a clean, readable sans-serif for body text and navigation.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (small radius) on buttons and image containers, maintaining a refined aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and spacious, particularly in hero and between major content sections, creating a sense of luxury and allowing visuals to breathe.

standout: The site's distinctive use of high-end architectural photography and video, combined with a sophisticated dark mode aesthetic and elegant serif typography, immediately conveys a sense of luxury, precision, and craftsmanship. The design effectively uses visual storytelling to elevate a practical service into a premium experience.
